provenance.scope: Native Lightroom Classic UI loading and six TIFF exports of one CC0 RAW; compare with the embedded camera Natural JPEG.

baseline.scope: Same DNG camera Natural embedded JPEG agreement; not reference-chart accuracy or firmware-mode calibration.

reference.preview_color_space: sRGB from DNG PreviewColorSpace; no ICC in standalone JPEG

engine.conversion: LittleCMS tificc, relative colorimetric intent, BPC off, float32 CIELAB D50; TIFF embedded ICC; JPEG assigned builtin sRGB
engine.roi: Native 200×200 half-open boxes shifted by rounded transformed centers. No resampling; median per Lab component. Inset sensitivity uses center 100×100.
engine.tificc_banner: Little CMS ICC profile applier for TIFF - v6.3 [LittleCMS 2.12]

registration.method: Green Sobel magnitude, Gaussian sigma 1.4, normalized 140px template correlation; four-corner homography; 15 held-out grid junctions

gamut.scope: Matched same-profile TIFF export-space diagnostic on #1376
gamut.geometry: Same 24 native 200x200 ROIs; local structural registration over 19 sites per export pair.
gamut.method: ProPhoto native to float32 Lab D50 and to RGB16 using exact embedded sRGB destination ICC. LittleCMS relative intent, BPC off, precomputation disabled (-c0) for main RGB16 prediction. Also records -c1 endpoint sensitivity. Independent signed linear sRGB estimate inverts the sRGB ICC D50 colorant matrix before TRCs. Differences can include CMM/quantization as well as export processing.
gamut.tificc_banner: Little CMS ICC profile applier for TIFF - v6.3 [LittleCMS 2.12]
